editorial:
Imagine being so bad at everything that you cannot even fail properly. That is the life of Norman Puckle, a clumsy guy who just cannot catch a break. After a heartbreaking rejection from his crush, Marlene, he tries to end it all at a cliff called Lover's Leap. Luckily, a Navy officer stops him and promises that joining the Royal Navy is the secret to meeting plenty of girls. You will find yourself rooting for Norman even as he accidentally destroys everything in his path during basic training. The vibe is lighthearted and silly, making it a great choice for a lazy Sunday afternoon when you just want to laugh at some old-school slapstick humor.

What really makes this work is how the movie plays with the idea of being average. The biggest laugh comes when the higher-ups mistake Norman's total lack of skill for being a typical British sailor, leading him to be the guinea pig for a space rocket. While the pacing slows down a bit in the middle, the funny situations keep you interested. If you enjoy classic British comedies, you should definitely check this out. You can grab the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best quality, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when Norman actually blasts off in the experimental rocket. Despite all his mistakes on the ground, his clumsy nature actually helps him survive the flight. He returns to Earth as a national hero, proving that sometimes being totally average is exactly what you need to succeed. He finally gets the respect he never had and manages to win over the girl of his dreams, wrapping up the story on a happy note.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old British comedies and underdog stories.
